functions.name: remPio2
functions.notes: Double-precision argument reduction rem_pio2. Fixed quadrants for |x| <= 9pi/4 with special pi/2 and 2pi/2 cancellation routed to the medium path; medium path rounds n, reduces with PIO2_1/1T and refines with 2/2T, 3/3T when exponent gaps demand it; large path splits the scaled mantissa into 24-bit limbs and delegates to native 285. Mirrors the 48-byte frame.

validation.comparison: 768 patterns cover quadrants, all threshold edges, cancellation points, medium refinement, subnormals, Inf/NaN and Payne-Hanek inputs. Each compares result, both output words, complete memory and stack pointer.
limitations: Out-of-range p1 pointers are not enumerated.
Ledger: 266 server bodies recovered and 468 remain machine code.
